model.title: Empowering France to accede to the Inter-American Convention for the Protection and Conservation of Sea Turtles

summary.text: This proposal would allow France to join an international agreement focused on protecting and conserving sea turtles in the Americas. The measure aims to extend France's commitment to safeguarding these endangered marine animals through cooperation with other countries in the region.
